purpose: Records the docs/manifest-only audit of whether the actual project varna/Kosha/KCPR/CSR-STL sources can instantiate the B1.6 Symbol-U scaffold for a frozen pilot. They cannot, without inventing mappings and resolving acronym ambiguity; this manifest records the sources, their hashes, and the blocking findings. No generation, no judging, no evidence freeze.

candidate_scaffold_sources.key_space: 34 Sanskrit consonant varnas (ka, kha, ga ... ksha); no vowels
candidate_scaffold_sources.semantic_leakage_note: per-varna 'notes' carry vrtti gloss phrases (e.g. 'hope / forward-grasping desire'); leak_risk=high; must never be sent verbatim to a judge; scaffold would use axis contributions, not gloss text

candidate_scaffold_sources.self_declared_status: researcher_interpretive_extraction; unvalidated_candidate_representation; source_supplies_four_spheres=false; must_freeze_before_run (shipped as unfrozen draft)
candidate_scaffold_sources.semantic_leakage_note: root names (moha/bhaya/kama/trishna/lobha) are high leak risk and must be stripped before any judge exposure

candidate_scaffold_sources.contains: the 10 signed polarity axes used by the polarity table

candidate_scaffold_sources.note: the frozen vrtti glosses the polarity table was authored from; semantic-leakage source (dictionary-like gloss) - excluded from any judge-facing text

candidate_scaffold_sources.output_key_space: 39 phoneme keys (a, aa, ax, b, ch, d, ... zh); bare phonemes/vowels
candidate_scaffold_sources.note: Stage A-prime is the decomposer named by B1_6_PILOT_TARGET_SET_AND_SCAFFOLD_FREEZE_PLAN.md sec 7

decomposition_join_audit.conclusion: No frozen mapping joins the decomposer's phoneme sequence to the varna profile/polarity/sphere tables. Building VARNA_PROFILE_TABLE for any target would require inventing a phoneme->varna bridge (and vowels have no varna entry at all), which the pilot plan forbids. Also true for the original Stage A 14-grapheme chart (also no ka/kha keys).

csr_stl_audit.conclusion: CSR and STL each carry multiple conflicting expansions across the repo; none is anchored in the frozen primitive_sequence_recovery varna sources, and those sources contain no CSR/STL fields. A frozen {CSR_STL_FRAME} cannot be derived without a choice the frozen sources do not make.

kcpr_kosha_audit.kcpr_defined_as: a decoder-side pole-selection rule (VARNA_ATTRIBUTE_KCPR_EXPERIMENT_RULES.md); kosha condition is experimentally assigned and frozen before generation, not read from a lexicon
kcpr_kosha_audit.conclusion: No frozen kosha->varna lexicon and no per-target kosha assignment source exist; KCPR is never expanded in-repo. A frozen {KCPR_CONTEXT_FRAME} cannot be instantiated per target without inventing an assignment rule.
